probability_space: for each block size, sample one uniform rate-half linear injection and reuse it in every outer row; independently sample every row coordinate permutation, region permutation, and RandomStepConv map
outer_average: for occupation one, each fixed nonzero local message maps to a uniform nonzero block word; linearity of expectation is exact and does not resample the constituent across outer rows
limitations: Nearest binary64 arithmetic is not an outward certificate.
Occupations two and above require the joint law induced by reusing one constituent.
